description: This file defines a PHP class 'Config' within the 'OrangeHRM\Config' namespace. It provides configuration management functionalities such as retrieving, setting, and managing configuration parameters, as well as constants representing configuration keys used throughout the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A class providing static methods and constants for managing system configurations and settings within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter by name, with optional default.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a configuration parameter exists.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the configuration is properly installed/enabled.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Returns the configuration object, optionally forcing reinitialization.
